shellCommands.command: git diff package.json && echo "---VERSION---" && cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"' | head -1

grep -rl 'prerender' .next/server/app 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---STATIC HTML---"; find .next/server/app -name '*.html' | head; echo "---NAV CHECK---"; grep -o '<nav>Operations</nav>' .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null || echo "nav not found in index.html"; echo "---REQUEST ID CHECK (should NOT be baked)---"; grep -c 'Request .* generated at' .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null || echo "0 (good - not baked in)"

echo "---FALLBACK in static shell (should be present)---"; grep -o 'Loading request metadata' .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null || echo "fallback not found"; echo; echo "---Suspended chunk files---"; find .next/server/app -name '*.html' -o -name '*.txt' | sort; echo; echo "---Dynamic metadata in a streamed chunk---"; grep -rl 'generated at' .next/server/app 2>/dev/null | grep -v index.html | head
